bobopomarancza: At the depot, Gustav Bobopomaranc had practised answering to his name. At P-F8, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Gustav Bobopomaranc fired, and Bastian "Bones" Jit was grazed. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Gustav Bobopomaranc helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Gustav Bobopomaranc was hit in the forearm at P-F8. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Nils Tuj of the Concord (@t.0uj0).
Gustav Bobopomaranc came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
The water jacket hissed as Gustav Bobopomaranc fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Hugo Jak was grazed.

Gustav Bobopomaranc was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at P-F8. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Zeno Franzcalamar of the Concord (@franzcalamari).

The men at P-F8 heard Gustav Bobopomaranc call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Walter "Spark" Cthulhu of the Concord (@cthulhu1703). Gustav Bobopomaranc was hit at P-F8 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Walter "Spark" Cthulhu of the Concord (@cthulhu1703).
The papers connected Casimir "Shadow" Bobopomaranc to Gustav Bobopomaranc. The men took longer to learn Casimir "Shadow" Bobopomaranc's own habits, but they made the effort.
Casimir "Shadow" Bobopomaranc fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Walter "Spark" Cthulhu, grazed.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Pavel Jit stood up to sing louder, and Casimir fired. Pavel Jit was grazed. The singing stopped.
cream_nugg: Zeno "Lucky" Nugg reported to R-R9 with a lucky button sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Zeno "Lucky" Nugg helped stack spare sandbags at R-R9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Zeno "Lucky" Nugg watched a woman sweep her doorstep. He had forgotten that dirt could be removed permanently from anywhere. The clerk counted the names twice. Zeno "Lucky" Nugg is number 801 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-R9 with the rations. Zeno "Lucky" Nugg ate while listening to the revised orders.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Zeno "Lucky" Nugg across the shin at R-R9. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Silas Nicopaoletto of the Hegemony (@nicopaoletto).

The men at R-R9 heard Zeno "Lucky" Nugg call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Gustav "Ghost" Xiii of the Hegemony (@masis_xiii). Zeno "Lucky" Nugg was killed at R-R9 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Gustav "Ghost" Xiii of the Hegemony (@masis_xiii).
Pavel "Ash" Nugg had heard about Zeno "Lucky" Nugg's courage. At R-R9, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Pavel "Ash" Nugg found a chair in the barn and sat down carefully, as if it might be reserved for someone of higher rank.
Karel Bachini gave Pavel "Ash" Nugg the last match in the trench. Ash used it to light a candle so that Karel could finish a letter.

A round came through the loophole Pavel "Ash" Nugg was watching at R-R9 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Edmund "Smokes" Acakostic of the Hegemony (@acakostic11). Pavel "Ash" Nugg was killed outright at R-R9, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Edmund "Smokes" Acakostic of the Hegemony (@acakostic11).
Casimir "Crow" Nugg put a lucky button beside the bunk. Someone who had known Pavel "Ash" Nugg helped clear the shelf without saying why.
In reserve, Casimir "Crow" Nugg slept nine hours in a barn. He dreamt of nothing, which was the best part.

A bullet went into Casimir's chest just under the heart at R-R9. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Yann "Saint" Ain of the Hegemony (@mount.ain220). Casimir was killed on watch at R-R9. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from.
The papers connected Norbert "Mole" Nugg to Casimir "Crow" Nugg. The men took longer to learn Norbert "Mole" Nugg's own habits, but they made the effort.
dababyislike: On Day 9, Zeno "Spark" Dababyislike arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In T-S11, Zeno "Spark" Dababyislike listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A bullet grazed Zeno "Spark" Dababyislike's ribs at T-S11. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Tobias Cermitboy of the Hegemony (@cermitboy). From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Zeno "Spark" Dababyislike wrote to a younger sister who sends drawings that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Zeno "Spark" Dababyislike is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Zeno "Spark" Dababyislike made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.
Zeno "Spark" Dababyislike offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
The sergeant at T-S11 called out a range and a spot. Zeno "Spark" Dababyislike was the only one who hit it. Matthias Jawn was grazed.

Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Teodor "Brick" Uselesmagika stood up to sing louder, and Zeno "Spark" Dababyislike fired. Teodor "Brick" Uselesmagika was gravely wounded. The singing stopped. Blast from a trench mortar threw Zeno "Spark" Dababyislike against the trench wall at T-S11. Ringing ears, a split lip, and no intention of leaving.
Three days with a bandage, and Zeno "Spark" Dababyislike is back at T-S11. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Wendel Ruthenianfas of the Hegemony lost a harmonica in no man's land at the Sunken Road. Zeno of the Concord found it and has been learning the enemy's songs on it.
dtbutikof: The old hands of R-S5 have been here since Day 1. Quentin Dtbutikof has been here since Day 7. In a trench, that difference already feels like years. Quentin Dtbutikof reported for duty as a field cook. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

A letter reached Quentin Dtbutikof from Wyvern Cross. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Dtbutikof. Quentin Dtbutikof read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Otto Tyner wrote a letter for Quentin Dtbutikof's mother, because Quentin could not find the words. Quentin signed it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Dtbutikof. Quentin Dtbutikof read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Quentin Dtbutikof bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.'

Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Quentin Dtbutikof watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Dtbutikof. Quentin Dtbutikof read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Quentin Dtbutikof traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Dtbutikof. Quentin Dtbutikof read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Quentin Dtbutikof got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 467. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Quentin Dtbutikof helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Quentin Dtbutikof made soup from what the rats left. The men called it the best soup on the front, and they were not joking. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Dtbutikof. Quentin Dtbutikof read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The cook's fire went out. Quentin Dtbutikof relit it under his own coat and served stew that tasted of wool. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Dtbutikof. Quentin Dtbutikof read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Quentin Dtbutikof laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Dtbutikof. Quentin Dtbutikof read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The transfer made Quentin Dtbutikof a stretcher bearer. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Quentin Dtbutikof read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Dtbutikof. Quentin Dtbutikof read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A patient at the aid post asked Quentin Dtbutikof for a pencil. By evening, the wall beside the stretcher bore a drawing of a kitchen. Quentin Dtbutikof read the new letter by the light of a match, then another match, then a third.
The patient has added a stove and three chairs to the kitchen drawing. Quentin Dtbutikof asks about each detail while changing the dressing.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Quentin gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
hay_ant_hud: Roland "Ash" Hud left a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain behind in Rosenau and came up the line with a cracked shaving mirror. The men noticed at once that he talks to his rifle.
Roland "Ash" Hud was in the first hundred. The old hands in R-F10 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Roland "Ash" Hud looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A clear shot from R-F10. Roland "Ash" Hud badly wounded Nils Averelle and slid back down below the parapet.

A sniper's bullet hit Roland "Ash" Hud at R-F10. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Anselm "Parson" Rock of the Concord (@rotrek_rock). A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Roland "Ash" Hud was carried in at last. Roland "Ash" Hud opened his eyes today and asked for water. At R-F10 they cheered when the news came up the line.

Roland "Ash" Hud slept most of the day. When he woke, someone had left a cup of tea on the crate beside the bed. Hill 304 has been won. Roland "Ash" Hud listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Roland "Ash" Hud never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
Roland "Ash" Hud fired at a movement across the wire at R-F10. The man went down: Rafael "Button" Superfeisty, gravely wounded.
The patrol came back one man at a time. Roland "Ash" Hud held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone.
The sergeant at R-F10 called out a range and a spot. Roland "Ash" Hud was the only one who hit it. Wendel Superfeisty was grazed.

The Concord sentry, Pavel "Tin" Satan, shouted once. Roland "Ash" Hud silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@commander.satan) Roland "Ash" Hud came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Roland "Ash" Hud only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F10, then nothing but pain. Raider: Valentin Carlson of the Concord (@nicholas_carlson). The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Roland "Ash" Hud helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Roland "Ash" Hud drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer. Roland "Ash" Hud walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Roland "Ash" Hud healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
A round went through Roland "Ash" Hud's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Felix "Brick" Eddie of the Concord (@eduard._.eddie).

Roland "Ash" Hud is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. The new duty roster listed Roland "Ash" Hud as a sapper. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down. Roland "Ash" Hud bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.' Roland "Ash" Hud was invited to the Officers' Mess for keeping the front supplied. The colonel poured a real coffee and raised his cup: 'The front does not forget its friends.' The quartermaster had an Airedale terrier pup nobody wanted. Roland "Ash" Hud took it and called it Hector. The whole squad already spoils it.

The parcel for Roland "Ash" Hud contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade. A letter from home reached Roland "Ash" Hud before dusk. Roland "Ash" Hud read it twice and slept a little easier.

Roland "Ash" Hud went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Oskar Knightowlvt was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@knightowlvt) Roland "Ash" Hud jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Bastian "Lucky" Vpy. The Concord medics will be busy. (@v01py) Roland "Ash" Hud came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Someone at home had written the address three times, to be sure. The letter reached Roland "Ash" Hud anyway.

A bullet went through Roland "Ash" Hud's upper arm at R-F10 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Wendel Hans of the Concord (@lezu_hans). Roland "Ash" Hud got a letter full of small news: a new calf, a broken gate, a wedding in the spring.

For days Roland was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle. A thin letter reached Roland. Only five lines long, and Roland knew every one of them by heart before supper.
joshhposh: Teodor Joshhposh arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a book with the last pages torn out and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Teodor Joshhposh could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Teodor Joshhposh and Dorian Hensley tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. A letter from home found Teodor Joshhposh before the night shift. Teodor Joshhposh folded it small and kept it close. After what happened at the Hanging Bridge, Teodor Joshhposh asked to serve as a runner. Nobody argued. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Teodor Joshhposh folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Edmund Fedakidd of the Concord lost a harmonica in no man's land at the Sunken Road. Teodor Joshhposh of the Hegemony found it and has been learning the enemy's songs on it. A letter from home found Teodor Joshhposh before the night shift. Teodor Joshhposh folded it small and kept it close.

Teodor Joshhposh polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too. A letter from home found Teodor Joshhposh before the night shift. Teodor Joshhposh folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A round went through the rim of Teodor Joshhposh's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. A letter from home found Teodor Joshhposh before the night shift. Teodor Joshhposh folded it small and kept it close.

The medic told Teodor Joshhposh to keep the bandage clean. Teodor Joshhposh has been guarding it like a medal. A letter from home found Teodor Joshhposh before the night shift. Teodor Joshhposh folded it small and kept it close.

Teodor Joshhposh's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. Teodor Joshhposh kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.

The section held a competition for the worst joke. Teodor Joshhposh won before reaching the end of his entry. There was a letter for Teodor Joshhposh. Someone at home had drawn a small picture in the corner. Teodor Joshhposh laughed for the first time in days. Inside the letter for Teodor Joshhposh there was something extra, slipped between the pages: a sweetheart card, 'My Pal' (common). Teodor Joshhposh looked at it for a long time.

Teodor ran a message from R-R3 to the colonel's dugout and back in twenty minutes. It was a record, and nobody timed it. A letter from a neighbor reached Teodor. It told Teodor that the fence was fixed, the cow was fine, and the roof still leaked.
legonius: Edmund Legonius arrived with the Day 17 draft, carrying a pressed cornflower and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Edmund was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at M-F12. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Yann Myrlnmwstkn of the Concord (@myrlnmwstkn). Edmund was killed outright at M-F12, a single bullet from across the wire.
The papers connected Quentin Legonius to Edmund Legonius. The men took longer to learn Quentin Legonius's own habits, but they made the effort.
local_distinguished_person: Oskar "Spark" Person reported to S-F16 with a bullet that missed him sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
The transfer made Oskar "Spark" Person a chaplain. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Thunder all night. Oskar "Spark" Person kept flinching. The old hands said that is how you tell the new ones: they flinch at God. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Oskar "Spark" Person stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Oskar "Spark" Person traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.

Oskar "Spark" Person was peppered by shell splinters at S-F16. A medic picked them out one by one while the next salvo came in. A letter from home reached Oskar "Spark" Person before dusk. Oskar "Spark" Person read it twice and slept a little easier.

Oskar "Spark" Person crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at S-F16 holds again. The medics cleaned Oskar "Spark" Person's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F16. Hill 304 has been won. Oskar "Spark" Person listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Oskar "Spark" Person borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. A letter from home reached Oskar "Spark" Person before dusk. Oskar "Spark" Person read it twice and slept a little easier.
Oskar "Spark" Person has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots.

Oskar "Spark" Person watched fog gather on the wire until every strand carried beads of water. The sentry beside him called it expensive fencing. Now serving as a rifleman, Oskar "Spark" Person discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.
Oskar "Spark" Person and Valentin Thky made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.

At S-F16 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Oskar "Spark" Person turned around and took a shovel blow. Ulrich "Bones" Cocac of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Ulrich "Bones" Cocac of the Concord (@noel_cocac). Victory at Blackwater Canal. Oskar "Spark" Person let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Back on the fire step at S-F16. Oskar "Spark" Person says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign. The clerk counted the names twice. Oskar "Spark" Person is number 157 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Oskar "Spark" Person helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Oskar "Spark" Person put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
Oskar "Spark" Person got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Oskar "Spark" Person was found at the bottom of the trench at S-F16, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Oskar "Spark" Person was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout. Oskar "Spark" Person is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger.
Oskar "Spark" Person drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
For days Oskar "Spark" Person was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.
A parcel from home held a comb. Oskar "Spark" Person has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.

Oskar was hit in the thigh at S-F16. He crawled behind a sandbag and called for the bearers in a voice nobody had heard from him before. Shot by Silas Wwjd of the Concord (@aidengmj_wwjd). Oskar stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-F16. He did not get to finish the job.
A letter came with Florian "Crow" Person: "I am Oskar "Spark" Person's brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
mvuisak: Pavel Mvuisak stepped off the supply cart at R-F17 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

Bastian Xiii had Pavel Mvuisak of the Concord in his sights at Verdel Ridge for a long second. Pavel Mvuisak was lighting a pipe. Bastian Xiii let the match burn all the way down. Pavel Mvuisak walked the captured trenches of Verdel Ridge and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Rafael "Button" Superfeisty fixed the strap on Pavel Mvuisak's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Pavel Mvuisak lost a boot to the mud at R-F17. It took two men and a rifle sling to get it back. The mud kept the sock.

Pavel Mvuisak had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any. A letter from home found Pavel Mvuisak before the night shift. Pavel Mvuisak folded it small and kept it close. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached R-F17 with the rations. Pavel Mvuisak ate while listening to the revised orders.

At roll call, Pavel Mvuisak's place stayed empty. Someone said another section might have taken him in. A runner was sent to ask. A letter from home found Pavel Mvuisak before the night shift. Pavel Mvuisak folded it small and kept it close.

The missing report was still on the desk when Pavel Mvuisak walked in. The clerk crossed it out hard enough to tear the paper. A letter from home found Pavel Mvuisak before the night shift. Pavel Mvuisak folded it small and kept it close.

The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Pavel Mvuisak asked if second helpings depended on the answer. A letter from home found Pavel Mvuisak before the night shift. Pavel Mvuisak folded it small and kept it close.

Pavel Mvuisak was hit in the hip at R-F17. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745). Pavel Mvuisak stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-F17. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745).
Felix Mvuisak put a lock of hair in a matchbox beside the bunk. Someone who had known Pavel Mvuisak helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Felix Mvuisak watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper. A letter from home found Felix Mvuisak before the night shift. Felix Mvuisak folded it small and kept it close. Now serving as a signaller, Felix Mvuisak discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

Felix Mvuisak and Emil "Brick" Xavidonegan tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. A letter from home found Felix Mvuisak before the night shift. Felix Mvuisak folded it small and kept it close. The clerk counted the names twice. Felix Mvuisak is number 161 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-F17, Felix Mvuisak listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Felix Mvuisak caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again. A letter from home found Felix Mvuisak before the night shift. Felix Mvuisak folded it small and kept it close.

Felix Mvuisak was hit through the stomach at R-F17. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Quentin Allistofeari of the Hegemony (@allistofearisgod). Felix Mvuisak was killed at R-F17 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Quentin Allistofeari of the Hegemony (@allistofearisgod).
Casimir "Ghost" Mvuisak arrived carrying the family name of Felix Mvuisak. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

Casimir "Ghost" Mvuisak made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration. A letter from home found Casimir "Ghost" Mvuisak before the night shift. Casimir "Ghost" Mvuisak folded it small and kept it close.

The last of the jam was shared by adding hot water and calling it a drink. Casimir "Ghost" Mvuisak approved the method. A letter from home found Casimir "Ghost" Mvuisak before the night shift. Casimir "Ghost" Mvuisak folded it small and kept it close.

The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At R-F17 they left Casimir "Ghost" Mvuisak behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Karel Engel of the Hegemony (@honey_.engel).
Albin Mvuisak took the same post at R-F17 where Casimir "Ghost" Mvuisak stood. He found his cousin's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

Albin Mvuisak of the Concord and Henrik "Shadow" Chauhan of the Hegemony share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at the Brickworks now wait for it before they sleep. The letter for Albin Mvuisak had been in the rain somewhere along the way. Albin Mvuisak dried it by the stove, page by page.

Albin heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot. Albin got a bundle of old newspapers from home. {He} read them in order, even the parts about the weather.
rakan_1027: Anselm Rakan arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a letter he never sent and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Anselm Rakan kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand. A letter from home reached Anselm Rakan before dusk. Anselm Rakan read it twice and slept a little easier. Anselm Rakan bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.' Anselm Rakan was invited to the Officers' Mess for keeping the front supplied. The colonel poured a real coffee and raised his cup: 'The front does not forget its friends.'

Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Anselm Rakan went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. A letter from home reached Anselm Rakan before dusk. Anselm Rakan read it twice and slept a little easier. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Anselm Rakan answered to number 978. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-R16. Anselm Rakan has learned to walk bent double. Anselm Rakan became a runner today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again. A German shepherd came up the line with the ration party and would not leave Anselm Rakan's side. Anselm Rakan named the dog Blue. The sergeant pretended not to see.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Anselm Rakan across the shin at R-R16. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Walter Davebowlton of the Hegemony (@davebowlton). A letter from home reached Anselm Rakan before dusk. Anselm Rakan read it twice and slept a little easier.

Anselm Rakan's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-R16 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. A letter from home reached Anselm Rakan before dusk. Anselm Rakan read it twice and slept a little easier.

A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Anselm Rakan closed his eyes while someone else distributed them. A letter from home reached Anselm Rakan before dusk. Anselm Rakan read it twice and slept a little easier.

Anselm Rakan was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success. A letter from home reached Anselm Rakan before dusk. Anselm Rakan read it twice and slept a little easier.

Anselm Rakan crawled through a gap in the Hegemony wire and slid into their trench. Rafael Dilloncoll reached for a rifle. Anselm Rakan was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@dilloncoll2015) Anselm Rakan jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Ivo Zgeorges. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@zgeorges11) Anselm Rakan found a letter on the fire step, left by the runner. Anselm Rakan read it while the kettle boiled.

Anselm Rakan found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a wedding party, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire. Blue caught a rat as big as itself and laid it at Anselm Rakan's boots. The squad cheered. A letter for Anselm Rakan came all the way from home in nine days. Anselm Rakan counted them on the envelope.

Anselm was hit in the thigh at R-R16. He crawled behind a sandbag and called for the bearers in a voice nobody had heard from him before. Shot by Clement Hs of the Hegemony (@13_h.s_54). Anselm stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-R16. He did not get to finish the job.

A letter came with Clement Rakan: "I am Anselm Rakan's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. Blue did not eat for two days after Anselm Rakan fell. On the third day it walked up to Clement and sat down. That was that.
roman.and.evies.daddy: Norbert Daddy walked into P-F24 on Day 10 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

Tobias "Owl" Brick and Norbert Daddy tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Norbert Daddy read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Norbert Daddy felt a hard tug at his hip at P-F24. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Viktor Alien of the Hegemony (@sf_alien101).
The wound Norbert Daddy shrugged off has gone the wrong colour. He is not shrugging any more.
A medic stopped by Norbert Daddy's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Norbert Daddy had gone back to P-F24.
Norbert Daddy laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.
The rain did not stop once. Norbert Daddy slept standing up, wedged against the wall of P-F24, and dreamt of dry socks.
Norbert Daddy found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
Norbert and Marek Boi argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
stry_61: Severin Stry stepped off the supply cart at S-C7 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Severin Stry wrote the name in his diary with unusual care. Mail came up the line with a letter for Severin Stry. Severin Stry read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

On a quiet night Severin Stry (Hegemony) and Gustav "Brick" Scarentear (Concord) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. The clerk counted the names twice. Severin Stry is number 737 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Severin Stry shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Oskar "Tin" Oscarwildely of the Concord shouted a joke across the wire at the Bone Quarry. Severin Stry of the Hegemony laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it.
At the Brickworks, Severin Stry of the Hegemony and Ulrich "Owl" Anezka of the Concord spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning.
Severin Stry remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.

Severin Stry was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-C7. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Clement "Lucky" Johnrant of the Concord (@johnrant21).
The medics cleaned Severin Stry's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-C7.
The aid post ran out of morphine at four. Severin Stry held a boy's hand until six. Then he went back for the next one.
Severin ran out of clean bandages at noon and boiled the old ones in a mess tin. They were whiter than before.
tegan_baumann: Otto Baumann joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-C3 changed before the cheering ended. Otto Baumann shouldered another load.

Otto Baumann saw the glint of an enemy scope and fired first. The man behind it, Bram "Rabbit" Kream, was grazed. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Otto Baumann answered to number 810. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Otto Baumann watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
At R-C3 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Otto Baumann won the bet. Karel "Tin" Kjoj was gravely wounded.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Otto Baumann waited for that to change. When it did, Isidor "Mole" Raptor was badly wounded.
Otto Baumann fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Hugo "Brick" Reiddemars, now gravely wounded.
Otto Baumann moved to a new hide at R-C3 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Marek "Lucky" Chase, grazed.
A clear shot from R-C3. Otto Baumann badly wounded Matthias "Bones" Dawg and slid back down below the parapet.
Face blackened with soot, Otto Baumann spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Zeno Raptor was grazed.
Otto slept in the afternoon so as not to sleep in the dark. It is the strangest schedule on the front.
thurmansuper: On Day 9 Gustav Thurmansuper took a post at R-R10 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He talks to his rifle, and the men liked him for it.

Gustav Thurmansuper was hit through the chest at R-R10. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Dorian "Whistle" Aversa of the Hegemony (@aariele_aversa). Gustav Thurmansuper recognized the orderly today and said the orderly's name out loud. The surgeon says he will pull through. The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-R10, Gustav Thurmansuper listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

The bearers moved Gustav Thurmansuper's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Thurmansuper. Gustav Thurmansuper read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Gustav Thurmansuper is number 808. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Gustav Thurmansuper wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Gustav Thurmansuper healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
A rat stole Gustav Thurmansuper's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
Gustav Thurmansuper saved the last of the sugar for Dorian "Ghost" Romania's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Ghost's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
Gustav Thurmansuper mended the hole in Jakub Harrison's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Jakub says the patch is stronger than the trousers.
Gustav Thurmansuper saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.

Gustav Thurmansuper woke up at the usual time for night watch, even in the rear. It took several minutes to convince him to go back to sleep. A letter for Gustav Thurmansuper said the whole street was asking about the front. Gustav Thurmansuper did not know where to begin the answer.
New laces made Gustav's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.
tylerbec13: Ulrich Tylerbec unpacked his brother's pocket watch at P-F16. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

Ulrich Tylerbec had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any. A letter from home reached Ulrich Tylerbec before dusk. Ulrich Tylerbec read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Ulrich Tylerbec kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
The parcel for Ulrich Tylerbec contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Ulrich Tylerbec was waiting. Emil "Ash" Theteeternot was badly wounded.
Valentin Marius (Hegemony) and Ulrich Tylerbec (Concord) ended up in the same shell hole at Lantern Hill. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
Ulrich Tylerbec saw Bastian Smx freeze up on the fire step at the Ossuary Wood. Ulrich said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
Ulrich Tylerbec was on watch at P-F16 when the night raid hit. The men found Ulrich Tylerbec at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Roland Jester of the Hegemony (@jester.404).
Otto "Shadow" Tylerbec arrived carrying the family name of Ulrich Tylerbec. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Otto "Shadow" Tylerbec saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at P-F16 and fired once. Wendel Ruthenianfas was grazed.
Otto waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Dorian "Spark" Canales did, and was badly wounded.
wyatthohbein: "You're late," said the corporal when Zeno "Owl" Wyatthohbein arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Zeno "Owl" Wyatthohbein was carrying water up to S-R17 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Zeno "Owl" Wyatthohbein did not. Shot by Albin Jib of the Concord (@jai_jib). Zeno "Owl" Wyatthohbein was killed on watch at S-R17. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Albin Jib of the Concord (@jai_jib).
The House of Wyatthohbein sent Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein after Zeno "Owl" Wyatthohbein. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein woke with his hair frozen to the sandbags. The cook brought tea so hot it hurt. Nobody complained. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein aimed a step ahead and fired: Walter "Mole" Dobremateico, grazed. Orders assigned Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein to work as a chaplain. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein offered a biscuit for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. A letter from home found Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein before the night shift. Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein folded it small and kept it close.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet went through Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein's sleeve at S-R17 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve.

Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-R17 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. A letter from home found Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein before the night shift. Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein folded it small and kept it close.

In the dark of the Concord trench Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein hit Nils "Rabbit" Toastybweady with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@toastybweady) Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. A letter for Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein said the whole street was asking about the front. Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein did not know where to begin the answer.

Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing. The letter for Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein liked the crossed-out parts best.

Bram held a service in a shell hole. Eleven men came. Two of them had never prayed before. Both of them asked for another. The mail sergeant held up an envelope and shouted a name. It was Bram. The whole trench clapped.
